'''Bos-Una Three''' was a location whose mines were widely believed to be mythical until the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when a lump of metal from the mines was discovered and traced back to Bos-Una Three.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|The Myth Metal}}</ref>
